scenario: Unapproved inbox forwarding persists after anomalous interactive-session revocation
confirmed: Successful unmanaged sign-in from unclassified source
New-InboxRule audit tied to that session and source
Unapproved external forwarding rule matching invoice subjects
Three distinct messages with modeled external forward delivery
One successful forward delivery after interactive-session revocation
Disable-InboxRule audit and disabled rule snapshot
Later modeled inbox deliveries without external forward rows
not_proven: Password theft, MFA bypass, or initial access mechanism
Who physically operated the new session
External recipient read, retention, or onward dissemination
No other forwarding paths exist outside the supplied data
The absence of a forwarding event alone conclusively proves containment
decision: Disable unapproved forwarding, investigate the account and other mailbox forwarding paths, scope delivered messages, verify state and follow-on traces. Preserve legitimate approved forwarding rules.
